ideas.title: Scrub Dinos for Cash
ideas.hook: Muddy dinosaurs stomp into your dino wash. Scrub, rinse and dry them before they lose patience, then upgrade to bigger dinos and fancier soaps.
core_loop: A dino walks into your wash bay
Scrub the mud spots with a sponge or pressure hose
Collect the tip based on how clean it is
Buy bigger bays, faster hoses and rarer dino customers
ideas.twist: Each dino has a mood bar: wash too slowly and a T-rex tail-whips your gear, so speed upgrades matter as much as soap.
retention: Dino customer index with rare skins
Weekly mud-storm event with extra-dirty dinos
ideas.why_now: Dinosaurs are the top rising theme at 2.24x ([☄️] Ride a Dino 27.4K CCU) and Job / shift × Dinosaurs is an open gap (3.90). Sell / run a shop is up 2.07x (🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 38.0K, Fix My Phone! 9.7K) and "___ for ___" titles are up 3.45x.
ideas.differentiator: Wash games clean cars and houses; here the thing you clean is alive, moves and gets angry, so every wash is a small timed challenge.

ideas.title: Paint Rocks for Cash
ideas.hook: Dig plain rocks out of the quarry, paint them into faces, animals or anything you want, and sell them at your roadside stand.
core_loop: Mine a rock from the quarry wall
Paint it with brushes, stamps and googly eyes
Put it on your stand and set a price
NPCs and players buy; spend the cash on bigger rocks and rare paints
ideas.twist: Buyers rate your rock; top-rated designs get copied onto a giant statue in the town square for the day.
retention: Rare rock shapes (geodes, meteorites) to unlock
Daily paint theme with bonus pay
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is up 2.04x ([🥞] Paint a Pancake 3.2K, Backseat Rally 19.3K) and Paint × Stones is a top-6 gap (5.43). Stones / rocks are rising 1.75x (Lift Rock For Eggs 6.6K) and Sell / run a shop is up 2.07x.
ideas.differentiator: Paint games sell canvases; here you also dig your own blank, and the shape of the rock you mine changes what you can paint and what it sells for.

ideas.title: Scrapyard vs Robots
ideas.hook: Rogue robots march down the lanes toward your scrapyard. Build turrets out of junk, and break the robots you beat into parts for better turrets.
core_loop: Place junk turrets along the robot paths
Survive the wave
Smash the wrecked robots for gears and chips
Craft stronger turrets and mech defenders from the parts
ideas.twist: Bosses drop their own weapon arm, which you can bolt onto a turret, so your best defences are built from the robots you beat.
retention: Weekly boss robot with a unique arm
ideas.why_now: Robots / mechs are rising 2.09x (Steel Fighters 16.6K CCU, Create a Robot Fighter 2.7K) and Tower defense × Robots is an open gap (4.70). Tower defense is up 1.69x ([🎃UPD] Cameraman Tower Defense 28.5K, Bunker vs Verity 13.8K) and lane maps are rising 1.31x.
ideas.differentiator: Most tower defense games unlock units from a gacha; here every unit is crafted from the parts of enemies you beat, so your build grows from how you play.

ideas.title: Sell Capes to Heroes
ideas.hook: Run the gear shop superheroes visit before every mission. Sew capes, stock gadgets, and the heroes you equip come back with loot to sell.
core_loop: A hero walks in and asks for a cape, mask or gadget
Make it at your workbench and hand it over
The hero flies off on a mission and returns with loot
Sell the loot and expand the shop with new counters
ideas.twist: Heroes you equip well level up and become regulars; a fully geared regular can defend your shop when villains raid it.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is up 2.07x (🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 38.0K CCU, Fix My Phone! 9.7K) and Sell × Superheroes is an open gap (4.27). Superheroes are rising 1.35x (Superhero Arena 6.1K) and tycoon building is up 1.49x.
ideas.differentiator: Hero games let you be the hero; this one makes you the shopkeeper whose gear decides how well the heroes do.

ideas.title: Fashion Fail Defense
ideas.hook: Badly dressed walkers are heading down the runway toward the judges. Place stylists along the path to fix their outfits before they reach the end.
core_loop: Place stylists (hair, makeup, shoes) along the runway
Walkers in clashing outfits march past
Each stylist fixes one part of the look
Earn style coins to unlock new stylists
ideas.twist: Walkers need a full outfit fix to score; a walker with perfect hair but ugly shoes still counts as a leak, so you have to plan your mix of stylists.
retention: Outfit index of every fixed look
ideas.why_now: Tower defense is up 1.69x ([RELEASE] Candy Kingdom Defense 2.6K, [🎃UPD] Cameraman Tower Defense 28.5K) and Tower defense × Fashion is an open gap (3.89). Fashion / beauty is rising 1.39x ([UPD✨] Makeup Salon💄 8.2K, Facecard: Makeup Showdown [⭐UPD] 7.9K).
ideas.differentiator: Fashion games are judged contests; this turns styling into tower defense, which brings a strategy audience to a theme it rarely sees.

ideas.title: +1 Bolt Mech
ideas.hook: Every step you take adds +1 bolt to your mech. Walk, grow a giant robot, and stomp bigger robot bosses in each world.
core_loop: Walk to gain +1 bolt per step
Your mech grows bigger and stronger
Fight the world's boss robot
Open part crates for arm and leg upgrades, then rebirth
ideas.twist: Your mech is built from the crate parts you equip, so two players with the same stats can look and fight differently.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is up 1.86x ([🌍WORLD 2] +1 Venom Evolution 10.6K CCU, +1 Assassin Leveling 10.1K) and +1 × Robots is an open gap (5.17). Robots / mechs are rising 2.09x (Steel Fighters 16.6K) and "+1 ___" titles are up 2.02x.
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow your avatar; here you grow a mech you assemble yourself from crate parts, which adds a building layer the genre lacks.

ideas.title: Crack Geodes for Pets
ideas.hook: Smash geodes open with your hammer. Every geode hides a crystal pet, and the rarer the rock, the shinier the pet.
core_loop: Find geodes in the cave
Hit them until they crack
Hatch the crystal pet inside
Place pets on your plot to earn gems, and upgrade your hammer
ideas.twist: Uncracked geodes sit on your plot while they cool down, and other players can sneak in and steal them before you crack them.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig is the top rising mechanic at 2.55x (Break and Steal an Egg 106.3K CCU, +1 Pickaxe Swing for Eggs 7.6K) and Break × Hatch is a 125K-CCU pairing. Stones / rocks are up 1.75x (Lift Rock For Eggs 6.6K) and "___ for ___" titles are up 3.45x.
ideas.differentiator: Egg games crack eggs; geodes give a mining feel and let rock size, colour and cave depth set the odds you can see before you swing.

ideas.title: Egg Inspector [Anomaly]
ideas.hook: Work the night shift at an egg factory. Check every egg on the belt and pull out the ones that are wrong before they hatch.
core_loop: Eggs roll past on the conveyor
Inspect each one for cracks, eyes or odd colours
Reject anomalies and pass normal eggs
Survive the night and unlock the next shift
ideas.twist: Some anomalies only show under the UV lamp or when you look away, and missed ones hatch into creatures that roam the factory.
ideas.why_now: Interior maps are the top rising map style at 2.21x (🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 38.0K CCU, Clone Baby Care (Anomaly) 14.6K) and Job / shift × Eggs is an open gap (4.38). Job / shift is up 1.28x and egg games lead the chart (Break and Steal an Egg 106.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Anomaly games mostly use food or rooms; eggs add a payoff, because a missed anomaly hatches and hunts you for the rest of the shift.

ideas.title: Punt Robots for Bolts
ideas.hook: Kick broken robots as far as you can down the field. Further kicks break them into more bolts, and bolts make your kick stronger.
core_loop: Charge your kick and launch a robot
It bounces and breaks apart down the field
Collect the bolts and chips that fall off
Upgrade your boots and unlock heavier robots
ideas.twist: Heavier robots fly less far but drop rare chips, so you choose between distance records and rare loot.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is up 1.68x (Cat Battles 🐾 20.6K CCU, [🎃] +1 Stone Skipping 14.2K) and Hit × Robots is an open gap (4.67). Robots / mechs are rising 2.09x (Steel Fighters 16.6K) and "___ for ___" titles are up 3.45x.
ideas.differentiator: Launch games throw stones or players; robots break apart mid-flight, so every kick is also a loot drop.

ideas.title: Paint a Super Suit
ideas.hook: Paint your own superhero suit. The colours you use decide your powers: red for fire, blue for ice, yellow for lightning. Then fight in the arena.
core_loop: Paint your suit on a mannequin
Your colour mix sets your three powers
Fight other heroes in short arena rounds
Win paint and stencils to make stronger suits
ideas.twist: Patterns matter too: stripes give speed, spots give shields, so two red suits can play very differently.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is up 2.04x ([✍️]DRAW SPELLS MAGIC ARENA 2.3K, [🥞] Paint a Pancake 3.2K) and Paint × Superheroes is an open gap (4.21). Superheroes are rising 1.35x (Superhero Arena 6.1K) and stylized art is up 1.18x.
ideas.differentiator: Hero games give you set powers; here your art is your build, so creative players get a real edge in fights.
